b1a_scientific_disposition: FROZEN_CHARACTERIZED_NO_SIMPLE_STABLE_REPAIR_RULE. Confirmatory retuning is prohibited. Any attempt to improve ranking/calibration must use a separately versioned development lineage and fresh untouched validation after candidate selection.
immutable_rule_summary: Historical virtual-world simulation is the primary path until final live confirmation (KR-016).
Offline simulation does not require live odds unless an experiment specifically tests odds.
Results/payouts remain separated from predictor inputs and predictions are frozen before dedicated scoring.
Exact circumference is preserved; no nearest-length coercion.
No guessed PRE fields, post-result cherry-picking, confirmatory retune, or unfavorable-case deletion.
GitHub is canonical continuity state; chat is ephemeral.
Runtime and automatic betting remain OFF.
